brief:
Israeli airstrikes and gunfire killed two young children and at least two other Palestinians in Gaza on Monday, according to health officials in the territory. Among the dead was 10-year-old Amal Abu Khater, medics and relatives said.

The violence underscored the ongoing toll on civilian populations in the strip. The health authorities confirmed the deaths but did not immediately release additional details about the specific circumstances surrounding each incident or the exact locations where the strikes and gunfire occurred.
